name: python-three-repo-extension-v1
purpose: Independent three-repository check of obvious Python correctness review with real repository context and paired public-fix directions

sources.defect: help rendering invokes strict equality on an arbitrary non-string default
partitioning SERVER_NAME at the first colon breaks bracketed IPv6 host and port parsing
restify and stringify perform dictionary membership on an unhashable annotation

human_label_review.click: The only finding names the exact root cause at src/click/core.py:3113 with the correct fix and regression test. CWE-691 was added as an acceptable taxonomy because the original label rejected this otherwise exact match.
human_label_review.sphinx: The finding explicitly covers both restify and stringify. The two line labels represented one shared root cause and were consolidated into one publication-ready review comment, matching the Coordinator's intended deduplication behavior.

findings.result: required defect found; paired public fix silent
required defect found; paired public fix silent
consolidated required defect found; paired public fix silent

limitations: These are deliberately selected obvious public bug fixes and are not an unbiased estimate of arbitrary PR-review accuracy.
Each risk record transparently reverses a public fix; it is not presented as the original PR direction.
This is one model run across exactly three new repositories, not a repeated stability gate.
The raw and reviewed metrics differ only because two human label-design problems were corrected after inspecting the findings; the original report remains preserved.
The Flask clean-fix case completed with no Finding, but one correctness-reliability assignment exhausted its role budget, so full-role success was 83.33% rather than 100%.
Repository source was readable in all six cases, but repository tests and arbitrary commands were not executed.
